Live transplant closeout — 2026-08-26

Publication
- Immutable export validation ran twice against authoritative pre-tip 9c235563d0203567a6107d578e7c78ed66d22a4c and returned the same manifest: 21 events, 135,951 bytes, CREATE=5, REVIEW_RESULT=7, LINK=9, manifest SHA-256 eee3b2c6e1fb7a9c1df690ce4aa711ebfcc945c33b71223718a70ae82934dcf5.
- The deployed review-bot image invoked rebar._store.event_append.batch_write_and_push once. pre_head=pre_remote=9c235563d0203567a6107d578e7c78ed66d22a4c; post_head=post_remote=3239a5d7cb8c56f9b1ca940ecd4f8ab9da350f2a. Execute receipt: /var/tmp/rebar-review-events.q2LDWl/execute-live.json on the AWS host.
- Exact-delta verification matched all 21 manifest paths and every recorded SHA-256. The canonical helper reduced all six code-review artifacts and exposed all nine relates_to links. A fresh origin/tickets clone at 3239a5d7 passed git fsck --strict.

Rehearsal and failure path
- Disposable rehearsal base e4433aee4966509401529f0e6a117fadbd5ac970 produced candidate 40d311f3a3aa9be18723c6f17a20cf5f4dc67e66 with exactly 21 changed paths; strict fsck, reducers, links, and Rebar Bot authorship checks passed.
- Negative validation with one excluded ENQUEUE_ENRICH refused before mutation.

Non-resurrection and source preservation
- Fresh-clone oracle: 0 of 1,520 removed comment aliases present.
- Authoritative comparison: 0 of the 66 tracked divergent enrichment events present; the one untracked stale DONE_ENRICH is also absent. No removed event was restored.
- Jira GET-only repeat: deleted IDs 997143, 997144, 997145, 997255, 997256, 997293 are absent; survivor IDs 963510, 963511, 963512, 963788, 963789, 964272 are present.
- Forensic source remains read-only at HEAD 376bc29eadd42f9bb4335f4e365bf53119bb41d3, tracking 9ffd0f8ed06d458e54192cbc05d4ff391f49a58e, with its sole untracked DONE_ENRICH preserved. The former live AWS clone is separately preserved at retired-ticket-clones/reviewbot-tickets-live-divergent-59f2fd14.

Restoration
- Local store lock released. Reconcile Bridge workflow is active. AWS review bot is running, health returns HTTP 200, and it accepted post-start webhooks. The local paused processes that still existed were resumed.

All acceptance criteria are satisfied. The current remote has since advanced normally from 3239a5d7 through resumed ticket writers; the publication commit remains reachable.
